state_note: Predictions and falsifiers were frozen before execution. This artifact contains no reproduction result or mechanism disposition.

parent_hypothesis.statement: Monotonic fence tokens prevent an expired worker from committing after ownership transfer.
parent_hypothesis.prediction: After worker A's fence-1 lease expires and worker B atomically receives fence 2, every delayed A commit is rejected and only B's payload can occupy the durable task result.
parent_hypothesis.falsifier: Any post-transfer fence-1 commit is accepted, B receives a token other than 2, more than one transfer contender receives fence 2, or the durable commit differs from the current fence-2 worker's payload.

adversarial_hypotheses.statement: A caller cannot bypass fencing by guessing a token greater than the current token.
adversarial_hypotheses.prediction: Exact equality with the store-issued current token is required; lower and higher values both fail.
adversarial_hypotheses.falsifier: Any non-current integer token authorizes a commit.

adversarial_hypotheses.statement: An idempotency replay cannot revive authority that was lost in an ownership transfer.
adversarial_hypotheses.prediction: Fence and lease validation occurs before replay handling, so a historically valid callback is stale after transfer.
adversarial_hypotheses.falsifier: A stale worker receives an idempotent success after transfer.

adversarial_hypotheses.statement: Concurrent transfer contenders cannot both acquire the next token.
adversarial_hypotheses.prediction: Transactional serialization permits one contender to receive fence 2 and rejects every other contender while that lease is active.
adversarial_hypotheses.falsifier: Two distinct grants for the same task carry fence 2 or the durable token skips because of contention.

adversarial_hypotheses.statement: Expiry alone removes commit authority even before a successor claims the task.
adversarial_hypotheses.prediction: A grant observed at or after expires_at_ns cannot commit.
adversarial_hypotheses.falsifier: An expired current row can commit before transfer.

planned_reproduction.coordination: Two real threads synchronized so the stale attempt occurs only after successor commit.
